scope: Independent administrative review of frozen population, lexical selection, calibration exclusions and descendant follow-up bounds; no semantic Nanoda source inspection.

checks.name: whole_reachable_nonmerge_population
checks.method: Exact independent git rev-list --no-merges LOWER..TIP equality; no first-parent restriction.

checks.name: ranking_and_diverse_signal_selection
checks.method: Scores count binary lexical families; descending score/full-SHA rank; fixed order greedy assignment gives four distinct families for the fixed sample. All four selected IDs are the first four eligible ranked commits.

checks.name: controls
checks.method: Python Random(20260909).sample selects two distinct IDs from remaining eligible full-SHA-sorted IDs; population is not filtered by score for controls.

checks.name: descendant_gate
checks.method: All six frozen lists independently equal first ten IDs from git rev-list --ancestry-path --topo-order --reverse CHILD..bound-tip.

checks.name: administrative_regressions
coverage: rank tie/full SHA ordering and repeated-family skip
refusal to overwrite and check drift rejection

limitations: Lexical signals indicate diff features, not semantic risk, reachability or test coverage; size/churn confounds remain explicit.

Greedy family assignment is deterministic but is not a maximum matching algorithm for arbitrary future populations. This fixed sample obtains all four required distinct families, so no selection change is needed.

This review checks the frozen selection and bound follow-up sets; the root must preserve commitment ordering and enforce semantic inspection limits, current-tip continuity and final ledger obligations.
